title: Mission 2 — The Secrets of Aiabiko
default_clue: Follow the current mission audio instructions.

node_clues.enter_sol_mission_2_start: Incoming transmission — press CTRL+C to answer.
node_clues.call_acccpted_com_to_beacon_to_talk_secu: Approach the Unregistered Comms Beacon near Europa, drop from supercruise and select the beacon.
node_clues.can_i_count_on_you: Press CTRL+A to accept the mission.
node_clues.mission_2_briefing: Read the secure ops briefing copied to your clipboard, then travel to Aiabiko.
node_clues.on_route_to_bardins_vice: Approach Bardin's Vice and land on one of the hills next to the town. Don't land on the pad or contact the town. There must be no records of your visit!
node_clues.now_near_bardins_vice: Land on the hill overlooking Bardin’s Vice.
node_clues.landed_near_bv: Disembark and explore Bardin’s Vice on foot while you wait for instructions.
node_clues.dissembarked_at_bv: Disembark and approach Bardin’s Vice on foot.
node_clues.landed_for_a_while: When the ship has landed on the pad, approach its cargo bay at the back to receive your advanced scanner.
node_clues.git_scanner_from_ship: When the ship has landed on the pad, approach its cargo bay at the back to receive your advanced scanner.
node_clues.waited_have_scanner_time_of_day_dependan: Check the operational windows and choose your next survey location.
node_clues.solar_briefing_mountain_dawn: The window to enter and investigate Mount Zoor has just opened. Locate the mountain and make your approach.
node_clues.solar_briefing_mountain_late: The window to enter and investigate Mount Zoor is closing. Locate the mountain quickly and make your approach.
node_clues.solar_briefing_canyon_open: The window to enter and investigate The Ayasai Canyon site is open. Locate the canyon and make your approach.
node_clues.solar_briefing_wait: It’s currently the middle of night at Mount Zoor. Only a madman would attempt to ascend it in the dark. You will have to wait until Dawn. And it’s still day at the canyon. You must wait for the cover of night to enter it. While you wait... Aiabiko 9 a has tons of lush oasis with plant life. Scanning all 6 of its life forms will yield you several million credits.
node_clues.underway_to_mission_activity_choice_now: Choose an open survey area: Mount Zoor or Ayasai Canyon.
node_clues.aiabiko_9a_entered: Choose an open survey area: Mount Zoor or Ayasai Canyon.
node_clues.aiabiko_locations_choices: Choose an open survey area: Mount Zoor or Ayasai Canyon.
node_clues.cave_arrival: Use your scanner to locate the remaining anomalies in Ayasai Canyon.
node_clues.back_in_ship_after_disembark: Take off and continue to Mount Zoor.
node_clues.waiting_on_take_off_from_cave: Take off and continue to Mount Zoor.
node_clues.canyon_survey_complete: Complete the remaining survey scans on Mount Zoor.
node_clues.mountain_climb_area: Land near Mount Zoor and disembark.
node_clues.on_foot_mountain_area: Use your scanner to locate the remaining anomalies on Mount Zoor.
node_clues.mountain_climb_area_exit: Take off and continue to Ayasai Canyon.
node_clues.mountain_survey_complete: Complete the remaining survey scans in Ayasai Canyon.
node_clues.all_aiabiko_scans_complete: Return to your ship and wait in orbit for further instructions.
node_clues.wait_for_odin: Wait for Muni’s reply, this would be an excellent moment for a coffee or toilet break. Muni’s investigation will take about 5 minutes. Or if you want to continue right away initiate super cruise.
node_clues.fsd_plot_to_earth: Wait for Muni’s reply, this would be an excellent moment for a coffee or toilet break. Muni’s investigation will take about 5 minutes. Or if you want to continue right away initiate super cruise.
node_clues.wait_for_spycraft_mission: Wait for Muni’s reply, this would be an excellent moment for a coffee or toilet break. Muni’s investigation will take about 5 minutes. Or if you want to continue right away initiate super cruise.
node_clues.glad_you_waited: Travel to Aiabiko 3 and approach Dewan Cultivation Range while remaining unseen.
node_clues.exit_super_cruise_at_aiabiko_3: Keep the range at a +/- 52 degree heading and land about 500 meters from the two main research domes. Use a Maverick Suit for this! Then switch to on-foot and approach the domes without being spotted.
node_clues.outside_the_main_research_dome_area: Enter and secure access to the primary research dome.
node_clues.wait_for_spy_craft_music: Press CTRL+A when safely inside the primary research dome.
node_clues.does_the_secure_sample_container_have_a_: Inspect the secure sample container. Press CTRL+A if its security level is 2 or 3.
node_clues.gather_all_the_other_samples_in_both_dom: Secure both research domes and collect all accessible samples. Press CTRL+A when complete.
node_clues.we_must_turn_off_the_alarms_in_the_lab_t: Follow the hallway and go up the stairs to the nursery and secure it. Press CTRL+A when you have the nursery secured.
node_clues.to_the_rght_of_where_you_entered_the_nur: Go right from the stairs where you cam into the Nursery. Then secure Restricted Lab B. Press CTRL+A when you have this lab secured.
node_clues.take_the_door_to_your_right_it_should_le: Take the door to the right from the lab, downstairs through the long hallwasy, and secure Restricted Lab C. Press CTRL+A when you have it secured.
node_clues.great_move_straight_through_l_shaped_hal: Take the door opposite from where you entered the lab. Follow the L-shaped hallway, go through the door on the right side, keep left and disable the alarms and ID scanners. Press CTRL+A when you have them disabled.
node_clues.ok_make_you_way_back_to_the_main_researc: Confirm that you remember the route back to the research dome where the secure sample container is. Press CTRL+A when ready.
node_clues.great_work_commander_make_your_way_back_: Run back to the secure sample container in the main research dome. Start the container-opening sequence, then press CTRL+A immediately.
node_clues.another_left_nursery_halway_stair: Run back to the power station, start the power-down sequence, then run back to the sample container, take the sample and exit the base before all the power shuts down. Then return to your ship.
node_clues.wait_for_action_music: Return to your ship when you are ready to leave the research base.
node_clues.hallway_left_central_resarch_dome: Set course for Sol and Abraham Lincoln station.
node_clues.wait_for_sol_finish: Continue to Sol and dock at Abraham Lincoln.
node_clues.sol_song: Continue to Sol and dock at Abraham Lincoln.
node_clues.sell_your_samples_at_the_bar_the_barman_: Sell your samples to the bartender at Abraham Lincoln. And use this secure link to file your missions report: https://florianrooz.nl/mission-02-report/
node_clues.sold_samples_at_bar: Complete the secure mission report using the copied link, then undock and exit the station like a boss.
